acceptance_walk:
I set up a worktree detached at fix/w8-two-homes (cddbfa3), ran pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and used --provider bench only. There was no real GitHub and no API key.

1) Two benches on one stand-in GitHub, started exactly as the README describes:
- Ada: `start.mjs --name review-w8-two-homes --daemon-port 49270 --ui-port 2870 --fresh --provider bench --githost 49272 --users ada,bob --org team`
- Bob: `--name review-w8-two-homes-bob --daemon-port 49271 --ui-port 2871 --githost-shared review-w8-two-homes --githost-user bob`

I walked it in the browser with my own Playwright scripts, which use recorder.openTwo:
- Setup assistant, first step on each app: name Ada / Bob, zone Europe/Zurich, then Skip for now and Start using Forerunner. /me answered "Ada" and "Bob". The device ids differed. Both agents are still called "Alice", a known gap owned by w8-shared-repo.
- Ada pressed New project: "Team site", with a brief, on https://github.com/team/shared. The plan card came, and she pressed Approve and start in the Inbox. 5 tasks were done.
- Bob pressed New project on the same repository. The dialog showed the offer, with Work together and its explanation and no Take it over button (scratchpad/walk-bob-steps/04-bob-offer.png). He pressed Work together and got the same project id. His Overview shows "Shared on GitHub with another Forerunner: each keeps its own tasks." (05-bob-together-overview.png).
- Bob pressed Approve and start; his session ran 5 tasks. On the stand-in, pull requests #1-#6 are by ada (#1 is her docs PR) and #7-#11 are by bob. The request log gives every call a login. Neither home wrote to the other's PR numbers. Each Overview lists only its own pull requests: Ada 1-6, Bob 7-11.
- `cut.mjs bob github off`: Bob's GET /projects/:id/pull-requests answered errorKind "unreachable", and his Overview shows "GitHub did not answer, so the pull requests are not listed. Try again later." (09-bob-overview-github-off.png). Ada's list still answered. After `on`, Bob's list came back (10-...github-on.png).
- `restart-daemon.mjs` on Bob, then a hard restart with his page open: the together line, his name and his device id are all kept (11-15-bob-after-*.png).
- Problems file after the hard restart: steps/problems.jsonl has 4 console and requestfailed lines with `/events?speech=play&token=[REDACTED]`. No file under steps/ holds the old or the new daemon token (L4i-left-54 fixed on the bench).
- Zone: Ada opened a session page ("Team site · session at 14:07"). Settings has no Time zone row. I went Settings → setup assistant → Back to the first step and changed the zone to America/New_York. Without a reload, the same window showed "session at 08:07" (walk-ada-steps/15-ada-session-after-zone.png). A second window stayed at 14:07 until it was reloaded.
- The Updates page shows the baseline model-watch report with nothing to decide, so the button race can only be checked by the UI test and Playwright.

2) Journey script: `journeys/two-people.cjs` on a fresh pair of benches exited 0. Result: 15/30 passed, failed (not known) none, 15 known, each with its owner. This matches the fixer's figure. Screenshots are in /tmp/frbench/review-w8-two-homes-bob/steps/ (for example 03-03-work-together-bob.png and 08-13-github-off-bob.png); the result is saved at scratchpad/two-people-result.json.

3) Single-user stand-in through the new proxy: `--githost 49272` without --users. A project on bench/seeded reached its plan card, and the pull-request route answered with no error. No regression.

4) Cleanup: I ran `stop.mjs --clean` on every bench (once with the owner bench stopped first) and checked every recorded PID with kill -0; none was alive. Homes are removed; only steps/ and bench.json are kept. Disk has 12 GB free.

Screens against the design: the offer, Overview and GitHub-off screens are plain one-sentence states with CHF only and no ids. This area adds no new person-facing sentence.

Scratchpad dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/9d17d664-b8c3-5e0d-8f13-1f917f72dcc2/scratchpad/

non_blocking: W8-homes-4 fidelity: cut.mjs closes only the REST API proxy. The stand-in builds clone_url from its own baseUrl (testenv/src/githost/store.ts:447), so the daemon's git fetch and push go straight to the stand-in's port while GitHub is 'off'. Bob's worktree .git/config has url = http://127.0.0.1:49272/team/shared.git, not the proxy port. The README says 'a refused connection, as when the network is gone', and the two-installs.ts header says 'the bench's cut.mjs cuts the whole connection'. Both are inaccurate. A session running during a cut would push its branch but fail to open its PR. Either send git through the proxy (clone_url from the request's Host, or have githost-server use the bench's via URL) or document the cut as API-only before w8-status-write relies on it.
L4i-left-62 check_in_the_app should read: Settings → Open the setup assistant → Back to the first step → Time zone. Settings itself has no Time zone row.

me-races.test.tsx 'a session page on screen follows…' says a setup-assistant change in another window makes this window read /me again via agent.changed. The real daemon sends agent.changed only on a rename (server.ts:3844), and the test fires it with renameAgent. On the bench a second window kept 'session at 14:07' until reloaded. The redraw mechanism is tested correctly. Fix the comment, or have POST /setup/profile send an event so other windows (and the phone) follow.

The acceptance asks for 'a screen rendered before /me answers shows times in the person's zone once it arrives'. The zone tests do not hold /me (only the L4i-left-3 test does). They cover a later zone change, which uses the same code path. A held-/me zone case would match the acceptance line exactly.

In two-installs.test.ts, the check 'Bob's home wrote no docs, marker, guide or status' leaves out the action 'other'. MEMORY_ACTIONS has no entry for ensureProject, ensureFields, upsertItem, setItemFields, archiveItem, createRelease or uploadReleaseAsset, so such writes by Bob, or unmapped stand-in routes, would pass unnoticed. Map them or assert on 'other' too.
The harness's holds and GitHub-off cases run on the memory host only. The http-mode githubOff (fetch wrapper) path is untested.

The journey takes screenshots at 8 of its 16 steps. Steps 9 and 16 are walked but have none; the acceptance says both apps at each step. A screenshot after the step-16 restart would show the together line kept.
The owner of the together-project name gap differs: the test comment says 'a finding for w8-together', while the report's new_problems says w8-shared-repo or w8-repo-guide.
docs/maintainers/testing.md: the stand-in bullet has a run-on, over-long line ('For w8-shared-repo (the person without write access). Tests: …').
UpdatesPage: if /me fails, the four model-watch buttons stay off with no explanation. Edge case; the app likely shows a connection error anyway.

Known D9 gaps also seen on the bench, owned by later areas: both agents are named 'Alice'; the person is 'me' until setup's name step is done; Bob's first plan repeated Ada's 5 tasks, giving 11 PRs; Bob's together project takes the typed name ('Bob's site').
